source.quote: 我觉得这个需求 加到stage2 能分出来这么多种就好了，数量可以不用管，但是种类的要求 可以加到stage1和stage2的默认规则中

priorities: readable evidence in the sole Stage 1 source
useful as a reusable independent object
deduplication: Repeated instances of the same object use one prototype.
Color-only variants, mirrors and alternate placements do not fill new prototype slots.
Attached architectural details stay with their parent object unless independently needed.
exclusions: fences and decorative terrain-edge bands by default
unidentifiable fragments requiring invented object identity
shortfall_policy: Report per-category shortfalls; never invent unseen assets or reallocate categories. In the full pipeline repair Stage 1; standalone Stage 2 reports missing source prototypes. Explicit user overrides use a recorded run policy.
semantic_deduplication: Manual/vision-authored prototype_key; this checker does not infer duplicate shapes from pixels.
